units: <cite ref="Chullin 60b">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> the Moon said <he>אפשר … בכ׳ אחד</he> is it possible for two kings to use the same crown (to occupy an equal rank)? <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:26">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>כִּתְרוֹ של פרעה</he> Pharaoh’s crown.

<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:5">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (play on letters <he>כ̇ ל̇</he>) <he>וקושר לך כ̇</he>' <he>ל̇עוה״ב</he> and he will wreathe a crown for thee in the world to come; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּתָרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:13">Ab. IV, 13</cite> <he>שלשה כ׳ הן … על גביהין</he> there are three crowns, the crown of the Law (learning) …, but the crown of a good name rises above all of them.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:5">Ib. 89ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 29b:3">Men. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>קושר כ׳ לאותיות</he> providing certain letters with crownlets (v. <cite ref="G00311"><he>זִיּוּן</he></cite>).
